name: Fuuga no Maya
source:
Earth Age: 17 years old.
Special Trait: Short orange hair and the teddy bear he sometimes carries around 
Element: Yang
Abilities: Can control bodyless spirits.

An innocent, spoiled child who likes to play tricks.
He's very sensitive and even the slightest thing can make him cry.
